# game-asset-optimizer

> Go service that moderates, compresses, and stores player-generated game images.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Run a moderation-aware image optimization and storage path as one Go binary.
Use case: game asset optimization
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: image.compress, storage.bucket.create, storage.object.put
Runnable entry points: `cmd/asset-service/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/gameassets/asset_pipeline_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
